controllingScope: Public website stays on Vercel. No portal subdomain or whole-domain migration. No website code, deployment source, DNS, DNSSEC, email or nameserver changes.
exactMatchScope: Only Host www.stackendbox.com and exact /client-portal or /admin prefixes bounded by slash/end. Their nested assets, callbacks and private APIs retain their full path and query.
originDefectFound: Old full-site candidate returned HTML for /client-portal/api/auth/identity and release.json. It must be updated to the portals-only gateway and matching backend before rules can be published.
stagingAndTestPlan: After explicit approval and commercial eligibility, record GET project routes and routing version history. Preserve the exact current empty baseline and IDs returned by subsequent staging.
Stage only the two proposed routes. They apply project-wide, so retain the exact www Host condition to exclude Preview and other aliases. Do not publish while reviewing.

Use Dashboard Test Rules for both exact paths and every nested asset/callback/private-API/download path, with realistic query strings. Verify homepage, /api/brief, /api/contact, /_next assets and near-match prefixes do not match.

Before publication, verify the isolated production origin has matching frontend/backend commit, JSON auth errors rather than SPA fallback, secure cookies and no-store responses. Keep its candidate origin override while testing.

Use controlled transport fixtures to verify Origin, Cookie, POST body, query, Set-Cookie, redirect and invoice/document response headers survive the gateway. Do not treat these as a genuine Vercel CDN authenticated test.

On approved activation only, set production backend origin to https://www.stackendbox.com, verify Turnstile hostname and Supabase callback allowlist, then publish the reviewed staged CDN version. Never use acceptance origin as production destination.

Verify actual main-domain login/MFA, activation callback, tenant records, invoice/document downloads and private API POSTs after publication. Validate ordinary public homepage/contact routes remain on the recorded original deployment. Stop and roll back for any failed critical check.

rollback.mechanism: Project routing History restore of the recorded known-good version, or remove/disable only the two portal rules and publish the restored empty ruleset.
rollback.initialHistoryCaveat: This project currently has no saved routing versions. Do not promise an existing one-click restore target. Capture/establish the approved empty-rules baseline before first publication.
rollback.timing: Vercel documents immediate application after publication. No website rebuild or DNS cache wait is required, but network propagation and in-flight requests prevent a guaranteed zero-time rollback claim.
rollback.verification: Confirm main-domain portal paths return to their previous behavior while /, public assets and contact routes continue using the unchanged Vercel deployment. Keep customer database records and the isolated portal origin.

commercialEligibility: Actual team remains Hobby. Feature availability on all plans is confirmed, but current commercial-use policy requires Pro/Enterprise or an actual provider-approved agreement. None was verified. No purchase, written exception or commercial permission is assumed, and production rules remain unpublished.
unverifiedBeforeApproval: Actual Vercel Test Rules execution against staged rules
